strategy: SOL — часовой диапазон, SHORT и LONG 1:1 v9

method.execution: Actual v9 Pine source in PineTS 0.12.0, observation plots only
method.entry: v9 retest touch; skip new-extreme historical bar
method.swingPair: At least one candle between central P1/P2 bars; reject adjacent pair and restart; trail P1 until P2
method.exits: Check from the next M5 after entry; simultaneous TP/SL is ambiguous
method.referenceRollover: Unresolved trade is recorded separately, without a fabricated exit
method.rUnits: 1R risk per trade, constant-risk comparison; no compounding
